name: Classic 3/4 Glamour Stance
editorial: A candid high-fashion editorial shot, dynamic natural movement, confident contrapposto posing.
body: angled about 45 degrees to the camera (3/4 turn), weight on the back leg, hips and shoulders counter-rotated into a soft S-curve.
head: turned back toward the camera, chin slightly down.
pose: one foot forward and lightly crossed; a hand resting at the hip, the other relaxed; poised mid-motion.
